data.sender_name: Kreis Musterdithmarschen – Fachdienst Waffen und Jagd (Der Landrat)

items.title: File Widerspruch against the rejection of the hunting licence
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Kreis Musterdithmarschen, Stiftstraße 8, 25746 Musterheide in Holstein.
items.computation: Bescheiddatum (posting day) = 19.11.2026 (Thu), sent by simple letter from a Kreis authority (not Finanzamt). § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG: deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting (letter itself cites this rule). Counting calendar days from 19.11.: day 1 = 20.11, day 2 = 21.11, day 3 = 22.11, day 4 = 23.11.2026 (Mon) = deemed delivery date. For non-tax authorities the delivery day is not shifted even if it fell on a weekend/holiday, but here it already falls on a working Monday, so no issue. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 70 VwGO analog / § 68 LVwG) runs from this delivery date and, per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number: 23.12.2026 (Wed). 23.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in SH, so § 193 BGB causes no further shift.

items.title: Submit a valid hunting-liability insurance confirmation to obtain the licence
items.quote: Sobald Sie eine gültige Versicherungsbestätigung nachreichen, stelle ich den Jagdschein ohne neuen Antrag aus.
items.computation: No fixed calendar date or period is given for submitting the updated insurance confirmation; it is an open-ended condition for the authority to issue the licence without a new application. Since the previous confirmation already expired on 30.06.2026, there is no basis in the letter to derive an exact final day.

warnings: No concrete deadline is given for re-submitting the insurance confirmation; only the Widerspruch deadline is firmly dated.
